title: The organisations in the existing cases, tested against every list
question: What do the debarment reports, the federal lists, the wage records, the other public bodies and the bid sheets show for the organisations already named in a case?
finding: 305 companies and nonprofits named as actors in the 128 cases were tested by exact name; 29 have at least one hit. A hit is a place to look and for most of them repeats what the case already says; the "found" column lists each one so that the case text can be checked against it.
how: Every actor of type company or nonprofit in this site's case files, with any bracketed note dropped, matched by exact normalised name against the lists used in the other screens of this file. "Recent teams" counts contract teams whose term began in the last twelve months.
limits: Exact name only: an actor written in short form in a case ("Recology") is not matched to its registered names, and for a common name the records do not show whether a federal-list entry is the same organisation. People are not tested.
